title: TransportOrderRatingFailed
description: The TMS couldn't rate an accepted Transport Order from its Shipper's Rate Card (Canonical Model event, version 1). The Transport Order stays Accepted and can be planned; Customer service can re-rate it. Published on the Transport Order events topic, under the correlation ID of the Transport Order's intake.

shipperId.description: The Shipper whose Rate Card couldn't price the Transport Order.

ratingFailure.description: Why the Rate Card couldn't price the Transport Order.

code.description: A stable failure code that monitoring can depend on. The codes are listed in the P2 process document.
